title: ToolBo
description: A little toolbox for the everyday. Calculations, conversions, and handy utilities, together in one thoughtfully organized place.

title: Weather App
description: A simple way to check the weather. Search for a city and get a clear picture of the conditions before heading out.

title: Calculator
description: Everyday arithmetic with a straightforward interface. A small project built around one thing: making the next calculation easy.

title: Tic Tac Toe
description: Two players, nine squares, and a familiar little challenge. A browser game that brings the classic back to basics.

title: Todo List
description: A dedicated place for the things you need to do. Capture a task, work through your list, and make space for what comes next.

title: IdiomYar
description: English idioms that stay with you. Explore lessons, practice with flashcards, and put new expressions into context with bilingual stories.

title: CPass
description: A small password generator for creating randomized passwords. The source is available to explore; the live demo is currently offline.
